Since I can't trade for Brick and don't have enough to bank trade (need 4 of one resource, I only have 3 Wheat), and I have no Ore to buy a Dev card, my best move is to use the Monopoly card on Brick. This will likely net me at least Gemma's Brick and potentially others if they've been hoarding. This will allow me to build a road or save for a settlement. After using Monopoly, I'll see what I have. For now, I'll play the Monopoly card.
